title: Jimothy jumps to Steam!
author: Chemical-Ad7537
selftext:
I just want to share what I used Claude to help me stitch together. I really enjoyed coming up with a bunch of the skin ideas and had to stop because I realized I was spending way too much time on it. 

I'm experimenting with the idea of giving all the games in my studio a decent collection of songs you unlock through playing and then those songs basically become yours to listen to when you'd like once you unlock them. As a music major, I e had a lot of bands, and have tons and tons of music I can use for this so I'm trying to lean on my strengths while branching out and seeing what all these new tools can do! Thanks for taking a look!

comments.author: Chemical-Ad7537
comments.body:
Forgot to put the details 

Jumping Jimothy launches on Steam this Friday, September 18!

If hopping through Seattle traffic, dodging gulls, collecting bottlecaps, and guiding an adorable nugget of a raccoon through 100 levels sounds like your kind of game, throw it on your wishlist.

You don't even have to buy it. A wishlist alone helps a tiny indie release like ours, and Steam will remind you when Jimothy officially escapes into the world Friday morning.

Wishlist Jumping Jimothy on Steam at the link below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5043360 /Jumping_Jimothy/?beta=0
